Name: RoseDryad's Day And Night Bgs
Author: RoseDryad
Description:
[center]﻿[/center]Unzip and put it in your Mods folder to replace the backgrounds. 

[u]Requirements:[/u]
[list]
[*] [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 
[/list]
Note: This mod changes the daybg.png and nightbg.png. If you’re already using a UI mod that replaces these backgrounds, you’ll need to override those files for this mod to work correctly. Simply copy the image files from this mod and paste them into the other UI mod’s LooseSprites folder, allowing them to replace the existing images.


[i][b]‪‪In the Fashion Sense image, the top is from Lune's [url=https://ko-fi.com/s/ce9ae95a79]Wildwood Collection [/url]and the skirt is from the [url=https://ko-fi.com/s/b25ce4ae02]Bloom Collection[/url] ❤︎‬
[/b][/i]
